title: formfabric

catalog.name: FormFabric
catalog.summary: Garment pattern design and cloth simulation: draw patterns, sew, drape and export.

notes_for_owner: UNTESTED: formfabric is registered for its first release (0.25.0, with FormSculpt and FormSurface on 2026-11-19), so no earlier run backs this entry. The app repo follows the contract: ./formfabric install, install-desktop and desktop build [--config FILE] (bash), and the same three verbs in formfabric.bat, so windows_shell is cmd; if the first Windows run fails in the bat path, set windows_shell to bash as formsculpt does. windows_msvc is true because the engine compiles C (ufbx) with the cc crate. rust_targets installs the wasm32 target the browser engine needs (rust-toolchain.toml lists it too). macOS: the engine is a PyInstaller onedir shipped as a resource; with APPLE_SIGNING_IDENTITY set, setup/freeze_backend signs every Mach-O in it with hardened runtime, a timestamp and src-tauri/entitlements.plist; none of this has run in CI yet. Intel Macs: every Python dependency has an Intel wheel on PyPI and the Rust engine builds on the Intel runner, untested until the first macos-x64 run. Signing is developer-id while Apple refuses notarization, as for FormSculpt and FormSurface; switch to apple when it works. Updater: plugins.updater names the store feed with an empty pubkey, so the app skips update checks until formcompiler writes the key at build time. Not in formportal's products.json: the catalog entry is written from the README and tauri.conf.json (project file .ffbrc from the file association). Add agents.mcp_launch {command, args} once the bundle path of the program is fixed: the installed program answers mcp as its first argument over stdio, so args is ["mcp"].
